messages:
Maya (FinOps): FYI — overnight alert: an ~12.4k untagged GPU charge showed up in us-west-2 on the March billing export. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/2026-03 (see line items 1427-1435).
CostBot: ALERT: Unlabeled GPU spend > $10,000 detected for project devlab-usw2 at 03:12 UTC. Recommended action: investigate tags, consider retro allocation.
Ravi (Infra): Ugh, devlab teams were running a batch of long experiments last night. I see a kube job that used the default SA — no cost-center label. Checking logs now.
Jen (ML Platform): We hit the same issue before — the job template forgot the `billing_label` env var after a rollout. I can patch the template in k8s and add a mutating webhook to enforce billing labels.
Evan (Eng Manager): Who owns these jobs currently? Can we auto-assign to eng-experiments until owners are confirmed? We might need to re-bill customer POC if it's customer-facing.
Maya (FinOps): Quick ask: finance needs a proposed allocation for retrocharge. Options: 100% eng-experiments (teams own experiments), or split 80/20 eng-experiments / ml-research (historical usage). Total to allocate: $12,421. Approvals: CFO sign-off required for >$10k reassign.
Ravi (Infra): Confirmed root cause: a deploy rollback removed the label injection daemonset. I'll restore it and redeploy templates. ETA 45m.
Jen (ML Platform): For the backfill I can run a BigQuery join on `billing_export.gce_instance` and `job_metadata` to map instances -> k8s job owner. SQL snippet: ```SELECT job_owner, SUM(cost) FROM billing_export WHERE project='devlab-usw2' AND resource_type='GPU' GROUP BY job_owner;``` Will produce per-owner numbers.
Evan (Eng Manager): If you get per-owner numbers, please show PFN (product feature name) mapping so we can decide if any of this should be credited back to customers.
Maya (FinOps): My proposal: run Jen's mapping, then allocate $9,937 to eng-experiments, $2,484 to ml-research. I'll open an approval request for CFO sign-off and attach the SQL output + raw invoice lines.
CostBot: NOTE: Affected resources flagged will be auto-blocked from new GPU provisioning until labels are present (policy: enforce-billing-labels).
Ravi (Infra): Patch done — label injector restored. Added alerting to only trigger on >$1k unlabeled spend per project so we don't get noise.
Jen (ML Platform): Ran the mapping. CSV attached to the approval ticket (internal link). Owner-level breakdown matches Maya's split within 3%.
Evan (Eng Manager): I approve the 80/20 split on behalf of Eng. Please route CFO approval.
Maya (FinOps): Filed approval ticket #FIN-2026-134 and pinged @CFO. Once approved I'll run the backfill charge command: `finance-backfill --invoice 2026-03 --map bq://project.dataset/output.csv --apply`.
Ravi (Infra): Also adding a pre-commit GH check to our deployment manifests to catch missing `billing_label`.
Jen (ML Platform): After backfill, recommend we add a nightly job to reconcile billing export totals vs tag totals and auto-create remediation tickets when unlabeled > $500.
Maya (FinOps): Agreed. Post-mortem: I'll draft a short blameless note and distribution to all teams that used devlab.
Evan (Eng Manager): Thanks all. Looping in @ops to inform customers if needed. :thumbsup:
Maya (FinOps): Closing thread here — will post update when CFO approves and backfill runs.
